name: Ghostwire: Tokyo – Prelude
source:
Visual novel that serves as prelude to [url=https://bethesda.net/ja/game/ghostwire-tokyo]GhostWire: Tokyo[/url].

The story of Prelude focuses on KK, a wisened detective investigating mysterious phenomenon set roughly six months right before the events of Ghostwire: Tokyo. Following a lead on a missing friend, KK and his fellow investigators stumble upon what can only be described as urban legends coming to life…

[Taken from [url=https://blog.playstation.com/2022/03/01/free-visual-novel-prequel-ghostwire-tokyo-prelude-is-available-today-on-ps5-ps4/]Playstation.blog[/url]]
